title: What If Your CRUSH Crashed Your MOM’S Car?
tags: what if you had to teach your crush how to drive
description:
Your crush has failed her driving test twice. Her permit is about to expire. And the only car she's allowed to practice in is your mom's minivan.

One rule: every scratch comes out of your pocket. You have $212.

Two questions for the comments:
1) What's the first thing your crush would hit?
2) Who taught you to drive, and did they yell?

Subscribe if you want to see what happens the next time Lia gets behind the wheel.

Real facts in this episode:
- 93% of US drivers in a 1981 study rated themselves above the median (Svenson, Acta Psychologica): https://trid.trb.org/View/180902
- Why it's 9 and 3, not 10 and 2: https://pemco.com/blog/hands-steering-wheel-position
- Target fixation: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Target_fixation
- 1.5 seconds to react before the brakes do anything: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Braking_distance
- One young passenger raises a teen driver's fatal crash risk by 44% (AAA Foundation): https://aaafoundation.org/research/teen-driver-risk-relation-age-number-passengers/
- One text = 5 seconds, a football field at 55 mph (NHTSA): https://www.nhtsa.gov/risky-driving/distracted-driving
- Drivers 16-19 have almost 3x the fatal crash rate per mile (CDC): https://www.cdc.gov/teen-drivers/risk-factors/

#whatif #gusmaybe #crush #animation
